recover_existing_records_first: FX10 and FX17 spatial intrinsics, lens/focus identity, spatial distortion/keystone
Fixed sensor-to-reference poses in a documented shared frame
Per-line encoder/timing and run 002 / run 003 start-position relationship
Original target dimensions and recording translation units

capture_geometry.target: Rigid, individually coded noncoplanar target spanning the intended plant volume; independently measured marker centres or checker intersections
capture_geometry.distribution: Spread controls across detector columns, scan lines and measured height levels; not a single elevated corner
capture_geometry.count_note: Planning recommendation, not a guarantee of observability or accuracy. Existing bounded fit API requires at least 12 train and 4 independent off-plane holdout controls.
capture_geometry.holdout_policy: Reserve an entire elevated target, height group or separated section before fit. Never tune model or choose thresholds on final holdout.
capture_geometry.height_levels: At least two distinct measured training heights, preferably three or more; a separate measured elevated holdout spanning the intended application domain

sensor_record: Raw cubes and ENVI headers with wavelengths and valid native pixel indices
Lens/focus, working distance, gain, exposure and scan direction for each sensor
Per-line timestamps and encoder positions or independently validated line motion
Persistent rigid start and end fiducials visible in both calibration and plant scans
RGB-D intrinsics/distortion and reference-frame transforms at the corresponding exposure
Capture time and rigidity checks; document target/plant motion between scans

acceptance.choose_thresholds_from: Smallest intended leaf region, measured spatial footprint and independent localization repeatability; null values are not approval.
required_checks: Noncoplanar rank and conditioning, distinct physical IDs/XYZ, unused elevated holdout
Axis-wise held-out residuals versus height, band, column and line
Positive optical/projective depth and observed detector/scan bounds
No extrapolation outside supported control volume
Plant-scan start and motion transfer validated using persistent observed fiducials
First-visible surface intersections, occlusion and mixed-pixel/footprint masks
acceptance.failure_policy: Retain unassigned spectra and null physical fusion; never substitute a plane homography on leaves

radiometry.white_reference: At recorded fixed settings; document spatial support, panel spectral reflectance and illumination stability
radiometry.dark_reference: True shutter-closed measurement with recorded confirmation and matching exposure/gain
radiometry.current_allowed_signal_label: Measured DN and provisional board-normalized Q / zero-offset Q0 only within reviewed support

backend_boundary: Offline empirical fit/project API only; not a completed visibility-aware cube-to-surface mapper.
